en.title: 3D interface: an overlay that keeps its shape, focus behind a dialog, handles before the camera, scenes by key, text from page fonts
en.body: From the notes of Tea Horse Road. `createWorld3DOverlay` takes `fit: 'contain' | 'cover'`, so the interface keeps its shape when a phone turns, and `overlay.box` says where it is. A node that held the focus when a modal dialog opened over it is published without the focus instead of making `publish()` throw. Transform handles take a press before orbit, fly and follow controls on the same canvas whichever was made first. `serializeScene3D` takes `geometryKey` and `deserializeScene3D` `resolveGeometry`, so a camp of geometry built in code is saved by name, not by every vertex. `createCanvasFont3D` traces 3D text from the page's own fonts, Chinese included, without a font file. The docs say that control callbacks must return at once.

zh.title: 3D 界面：保持比例的叠加层、对话框后面的焦点、手柄优先于相机、按键名保存场景、用页面字体做 3D 文字
zh.body: 来自《茶马古道》的笔记。`createWorld3DOverlay` 支持 `fit: 'contain' | 'cover'`，手机转屏时界面保持比例，`overlay.box` 给出它的位置。模态对话框在拥有焦点的节点上方打开时，该节点以"未聚焦"发布，`publish()` 不再抛错。变换手柄在同一画布上优先于轨道、飞行和跟随控制器拿到按下，与创建顺序无关。`serializeScene3D` 支持 `geometryKey`、`deserializeScene3D` 支持 `resolveGeometry`，代码拼出的营地几何体按名字保存，不存全部顶点。`createCanvasFont3D` 用页面自己的字体（包括中文）描出 3D 文字，不需要字体文件。文档写明了控件回调必须立即返回。
